title: Sweep every clickthrough page for checklist conformance

Narrow-width render (760px): clean on all 16 pages (no overflow, no squeezed canvas). Systemic warns rolled into task systemic-checklist-warns-across-clickthrough-pag. Root cause note for the seven g4 selection fails: walkthrough.js marks exactly one data-select node and strips .sel from every .lrow, so pages that select clips/pickers can never mirror into Layers.

Swept all 16 clickthrough pages (capture-wt excluded, owned by the harden task): all return 200; 14 fail at least one section 9 gate or a measured render check, 2 pass (img-grade-wt, component-configure-wt). Pass/fail table with evidence is in this task log. Filed 14 per-page fix tasks plus one systemic-warns rollup; no inline fixes. Verified via mechanical greps, live browser measurement at 1280px and 760px, and a structural audit of every page.
